data.name: A Life I Couldn’t Feel
data.detailed_description:
The gods have cast their judgment upon you.

You were given a life. Warmth. Opportunity. Love.
And yet you could not feel it.

For that, your soul is condemned to the depths of the underworld — not for wickedness, but for something the gods consider far worse: ingratitude.

Yet a sliver of fate remains. One final chance to escape damnation.

Reach the end of this passage… or be lost to darkness forever.

About the game

A Life I Couldn't Feel is a first-person psychological horror game set in a divine underground trial. You play as a condemned soul who must navigate a single, linear passage filled with traps, pursuing creatures, and environments designed to break you.

There is no combat. No checkpoints. No saves. No menus. The only way out is forward — and the gods who put you here are hoping you never make it.

Gameplay

Survive through observation, timing, and movement. The passage hides its dangers until it's too late — and not everything that can kill you is obvious. You cannot fight back. You can only read the environment, learn from death, and push forward.

Every corner was designed to kill you. The remains of those who came before tell you everything you need to know about your odds.

Completing the passage takes roughly 30 minutes.

Getting there will take considerably longer. Most players die at least 10 times before seeing the end. Each death sends you back to the very beginning — no exceptions, no shortcuts.

That is not a bug. That is the trial.

This game is not for everyone.

If you are looking for checkpoints, combat, or a forgiving experience — this is not it. If you want something punishing, atmospheric, and genuinely rewarding to beat, read on.

Features

One level. No saves. No mercy.

A single brutal passage — reach the end or return to the beginning

Dangers you won't see coming

The passage has its own rules — discover them, or die learning them

Gods who want you dead

Divine voices taunt you as you run — they built this place for you to fail

No combat, no weapons

Run, avoid, and survive — fighting back is not an option

Photorealistic visuals

Unreal Engine 5 with Megascans assets and cinematic lighting

Stripped to the bone

No menus, no settings, no UI — nothing between you and the trial

Playtime: ~30 min to complete  ·  Single level, no saves  ·  First-person  ·  Keyboard & mouse only  ·  No settings menu  ·  Contains AI-generated narration

data.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where survival means enduring a divine trial designed for you to fail. One passage, no saves, no combat — only the darkness, the dangers, and the gods who want you dead.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains dark psychological themes, including depression and emotional suffering. Players may encounter frightening entities and non-graphic depictions of violence during chase sequences. Some scenes may be intense or disturbing. There is no sexual content.
